title: Qafaraak Tumbulle Gira
intro: Bar tite le golo taswiir, baxxo le iffonta horizontal laqlaqissaah, dubuk yan safar abeeni woo iffonta fanah gexak, miraaciino gorrisak, dubuk imperiyal fooca fanah gexak, qanxaffe le agat currik yayyaaqeenimih farmo luk gexa.
clues: Anu alqih addat alil daqar amol daffeyseh suge Yalli yiinah ruube.
Anu yi ummatta xukko abeh yan caylaleelah buxah addal enbe.
Anu kudeh qidimih sittin way kee liggiditte tatruse Madiyaanal tamlimeh qarwa hanaawisak.
Anu qalek xaqul gira ubleeh, barkat le golol xongolot yoo seecime.
Anu namma caylale asta yomcowweh inni gabat: abeesa tekke caxxaa kee qado diifu le gaba.
Anu inni toobokoyta lih Masri amoytak naharal sooleh sugeeh, sarra ni kudah baddi baxsimtem uble.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Yalli seecimam Barkatle golol kee firqawni fan ruubem .
Soonoh addat baxa fida kah abaanam amrisen
gabul le malcina soono amoytah maqniseh
Adda xer badih addat kaxxa kullumti yanxuqeh suge
trial.answer: Yalli seecimam Barkatle golol kee firqawni fan ruubem .

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Firqawni qande leeh addat raddeeh, Israa-eel xaylo cattimteh.
outcome.answer: Firqawni qande leeh addat raddeeh, Israa-eel xaylo cattimteh.

verse: And he showed him the greatest sign, (79:20)
